question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence.

More than once in the course of my questionaire, I have questioned about your love for the country and culture.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"questionaire"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "questionnaire", which refers to a set of printed or written questions with a choice of answers, devised for the purposes of a survey or statistical study. (प्रश्नावली)

 
 
• **Example:** The company asked its employees to fill out a **questionnaire** about workplace satisfaction.
 
 
 
• The correct word is **"questionnaire"** which means a set of printed or written questions used for gathering information. (प्रश्नावली)
 
 
• **Example:** Before the interview, please complete this **questionnaire **about your previous work experience.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Questioned** (पूछा गया): To ask someone questions.

 
 
• **Example:** The detective questioned the suspect for hours.
 
 
 
• **Course** (पाठ्यक्रम): The route or direction followed by a ship, aircraft, road, or river.
 
 
• **Example:** The pilot changed the course of the plane to avoid the storm.
 
 
 
• **Culture** (संस्कृति): The arts and other manifestations of human intellectual achievement regarded collectively.
 
 
• **Example:** She is studying the culture of ancient Greece.
